nativeInternalCommandConstructor.qualification: Internal initialization only; loader then applies CommandList/file defaults. Do not use this as the authoring default.

rules.observation: Pinned parser accepts OR inside a step; current exported parser splits + and the matcher uses every(). Mixed + and | is rejected natively.
Pinned parser/input buffer recognizes L/R/N and absolute diagonals. Current command sampling/state evaluation explicitly tracks U/D/B/F only.
Current releaseMinimum is not a complete substitute for native InputBuffer.StateCharge; slash/tilde numeric prefixes, history, facing and bounds need native tests.
Native file compilation gates parse-error tolerance and ApplyBackwardCompatibility by engine version; mixed holds and helper AI differ.

Original sample documents a buffer upper limit of 30; pinned Ikemen loader explicitly clamps minimum 1. Current exporters parse integers without that clamp. MUGEN executable behavior remains unverified.

remaining: Native signed input/charge counters and facing-relative/absolute histories
